editions.editorsBrief: Morning edition — the STF crisis escalates onto a mutual-suspension track. Mendonça asks the full court to suspend Moraes while the plenary weighs a corruption inquiry tied to the Banco Master case; the Federal Police report flags up to five possible crimes by Mendonça as rapporteur; the probe now touches Primeiro Comando Capital; and a Sept 7 desagravo rally is expected with the Bolsonaro brothers.

leadStory.headline: Mendonça asks the full court to suspend Moraes — a mutual-suspension spiral and what the plenary can decide
leadStory.deck: The Federal Police report that names up to five possible crimes by Mendonça, the suspend-Moraes request now on Fachin's desk, and a candidate bench weighed down by Banco Master's PCC ties. What the plenary session is about to sit through.

stories.headline: Mendonça asks the full court to suspend Moraes
stories.label: CORROBORATED
stories.text: Mendonça asked the full court to suspend colleague Moraes while the plenary decides whether to open a corruption inquiry tied to the Banco Master case — on the same evidence (PF messages, R$131M contract) already headed to plenary analysis.

stories.headline: PF report flags five possible crimes by Mendonça
stories.label: PRIMARY DOCUMENT
stories.text: The Federal Police report mentions up to five possible crimes by Mendonça as Master rapporteur, including steering the plea deal toward chosen targets and handling police procedures ex officio.

stories.headline: Probe touches Primeiro Comando Capital ties
stories.label: CORROBORATED
stories.text: The Banco Master investigation widens to suspected ties with the Primeiro Comando Capital, Brazil's largest organized-crime group (a US-designated terrorist org), broadening the stakes beyond the Court.

stories.headline: Sept 7 becomes a stage
stories.label: SCHEDULED / REPORT
stories.text: A Sept 7 rally is set as a show of support ('desagravo') for Mendonça, with the Bolsonaro brothers expected — running the street and the bench on parallel clocks a month before October elections.

editions.editorsBrief: Tonight the case stopped being postponed and started being decided. Mendonça handed the Supreme Court's full bench the PF report the whole country was waiting to see — and reopened a deeper question: whether the court will wind down the very inquiry Moraes used against him. The PGR opinion still ticking, and a September 7 stage, round out the night.

leadStory.headline: Mendonça sends the Moraes file to the full court — who decides the plenary, and can the bench survive it?
leadStory.deck: A 218-page police report, a bench turning on itself, and a chief justice weighing whether the inquiry Moraes used should even survive. What the full court is about to sit through — and what the PGR opinion could stop.

stories.headline: Mendonça sends the Moraes file to the full court
stories.label: CORROBORATED
stories.text: Justice Mendonça tonight released the PF forensic report to a plenary session — the same report with 52 one-way WhatsApp messages to a contact saved as 'Alexandre de Moraes BRASÍLIA'. Only Fachin can set the date, and he could still choose a closed deliberation.

stories.headline: Fachin wants the bench before the full court — and may retire the fake-news inquiry
stories.label: CONFIRMED
stories.text: The chief justice signalled a firm plenary response and defended winding down the 'inqúerito das fake news' — the very vehicle Moraes used to request an investigation of Mendonça. Justice Dino publicly criticised 'applause-seeking promises'.

stories.headline: The PGR opinion that could undo the whole file
stories.label: PRIMARY DOCUMENT
stories.text: Prosecutor-General Paulo Gonet has already argued in writing the PF report is null — a judge may not order his own investigation of a colleague without the prosecutor's office or police. His formal opinion under Fachin's five-day clock is due this week.

stories.headline: September 7 becomes a stage
stories.label: SCHEDULED / REPORT
stories.text: Flávio Bolsonaro's Independence Day act is being planned as a public show of support ('desagravo') for Mendonça. With Moraes's fate heading to the plenary, the street and the bench now run on parallel clocks.
